Exam 4

1. Mean (σ Known)

Formula

\[ \bar{x} \pm z_{\alpha/2} \cdot \frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}} \]

R Workflow

xbar       <- ___
sigma      <- ___
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
z     <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

SE <- sigma / sqrt(n)
E  <- z * SE

lower <- xbar - E
upper <- xbar + E

lower
upper

What to Look For

  • σ is given → use z
  • Problem says “mean”

2. Mean (σ Unknown)

Formula

\[ \bar{x} \pm t_{\alpha/2,df} \cdot \frac{s}{\sqrt{n}} \]

R Workflow

xbar       <- ___
s          <- ___
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
df    <- n - 1
tcrit <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df)

SE <- s / sqrt(n)
E  <- tcrit * SE

lower <- xbar - E
upper <- xbar + E

lower
upper

What to Look For

  • σ not given
  • s is given → use t

3. Population Proportion

Formula

\[ \hat{p} \pm z_{\alpha/2} \cdot \sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}} \]

R Workflow

x          <- ___   # number of successes
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

phat <- round(x / n, 3)

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
z     <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

SE <- sqrt(phat * (1 - phat) / n)
E  <- z * SE

lower <- phat - E
upper <- phat + E

lower
upper

Condition Check

n * phat
n * (1 - phat)

Both should be ≥ 10

What to Look For

  • Words like: proportion, percent, defective, success/failure

4. Variance / Standard Deviation

Formula

\[ \frac{(n-1)s^2}{\chi^2_{\alpha/2}} < \sigma^2 < \frac{(n-1)s^2}{\chi^2_{1-\alpha/2}} \]

R Workflow

s          <- ___
n          <- ___
conf_level <- 0.95

alpha <- 1 - conf_level
df    <- n - 1

chi_upper <- qchisq(1 - alpha/2, df)
chi_lower <- qchisq(alpha/2, df)

s2 <- s^2

lower_var <- (df * s2) / chi_upper
upper_var <- (df * s2) / chi_lower

lower_sd <- sqrt(lower_var)
upper_sd <- sqrt(upper_var)

lower_var
upper_var
lower_sd
upper_sd

What to Look For

  • Mentions variance or standard deviation
  • Uses chi-square

5. X-bar Chart (μ and σ Known)

Formulas

\[ UCL = \mu + 3\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}} \]

\[ CL = \mu \]

\[ LCL = \mu - 3\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}} \]

R Workflow

mu    <- ___
sigma <- ___
n     <- ___

UCL <- mu + 3 * sigma / sqrt(n)
CL  <- mu
LCL <- mu - 3 * sigma / sqrt(n)

UCL
CL
LCL

Check Sample Means

xbar <- c(___, ___, ___)

xbar > UCL
xbar < LCL

7. p-Chart

Case 1: p Known

p <- ___
n <- ___
d <- c(___, ___, ___)

phat <- d / n

SE <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)

UCL <- p + 3 * SE
CL  <- p
LCL <- max(0, p - 3 * SE)

phat > UCL | phat < LCL

Case 2: p Unknown

n <- ___
d <- c(___, ___, ___)

m <- length(d)

phat <- d / n
pbar <- sum(d) / (m * n)

SE <- sqrt(pbar * (1 - pbar) / n)

UCL <- pbar + 3 * SE
CL  <- pbar
LCL <- max(0, pbar - 3 * SE)

phat > UCL | phat < LCL
